listing.name: Attuned Drive Field Hullmod
listing.summary: This simple mod adds an hull modification (Attuned Drive Field) that gives +1 Burn speed at at less efficient OP costs than Augmented Drive Field (6/10/16/28 depending on hull size). The mod is updated for the following version of Starsector: 0.98a-RC7.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hull modification that grants +1 Burn speed at lower OP costs than Augmented Drive Field.

description:
This simple mod adds an hull modification (Attuned Drive Field) that gives +1 Burn speed at at less efficient OP costs than Augmented Drive Field (6/10/16/28 depending on hull size).
The mod is updated for the following version of Starsector: 0.98a-RC7.

This mod can be enabled on an existing save, but will cause a crash on the save if disabled.
The hullmod is available and unlocked from the start.
The hullmod cannot be installed together with Augmented Drive Field, and will occupy a Logistic slot on the ship it is installed on.
Mercenary fleets, bounty hunters, etc. have a chance to include this hullmod in their builds.

Thanks a lot for your feedback!

< Download Here (Google Drive .zip) >

Install instructions:

Download the mod from the link above.
Right click -> put the main folder into Starsector "mods" folder (default path: C:\Program Files\Starsector\mods).
